sources.title: Proposal A
sources.text: Proposal A recommends SQLite for the first local notebook release. It uses one database file and a local browser interface. The proposed delivery date is October 20.

sources.title: Proposal B
sources.text: Proposal B recommends PostgreSQL for a hosted team notebook. It requires a database service and user accounts. The proposed delivery date is November 15.

cases.question: Compare both proposals, database recommendations, scope and proposed delivery dates. Preserve attribution. Organize a map with separate attributed proposal branches and cited relationships; preserve each recommendation and scope.
Use only the one distinct stated fact. A single cited root is enough. Do not invent branches or causal relationships to pad the map.

sources.title: Planning memo A
sources.text: Project Atlas proposes October 20 as its launch date, conditional on the security audit passing.

sources.title: Planning memo B
sources.text: Project Atlas proposes November 15 as its launch date, subject to final approval. No memo is designated authoritative.
